blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: While language-model agents excel at long-horizon coding and terminal tasks, this success relies on two conditions: explicit text specifications and immediate execution feedback. However, neither condition holds in real-world problems where critical information exists only in images, leaving it unclear whether long-horizon capability transfers from text to visual reasoning. In such visual settings, because rules and clues resist text transcription and lack test-case feedback, agents must repeatedly inspect images, simulate spatial transformations, and autonomously cross-check clues. Despite this challenge, existing evaluations fail to capture such capability: visual reasoning benchmarks largely reduce tasks to single-turn, short-chain question answering, whereas agent benchmarks focus on text-based environments or interactive states that permit trial-and-error. To bridge this gap, we introduce Visual Cipher Bench, a collection of 40 original visual puzzles across four categories: spatial manipulation and simulation, logical constraints and planning, rule induction, and knowledge-based decoding. Each puzzle provides only one to three black-and-white line drawings and a minimal submission instruction, requiring agents to discover the underlying solving mechanism entirely from the images. Across 29 reasoning-effort configurations of eight frontier models, even the strongest model, GPT-6 Astra (max), achieves only 26.7% accuracy, while five of the eight models score below 1%. Yet on a ten-task subset, providing a single non-spoiler mechanism hint boosts accuracy from 7.8% to 55.6%. This sharp contrast shows that the primary bottleneck of current agents lies not in executing multi-step plans, but in autonomously discovering rules from visual evidence. Visual Cipher Bench thus provides a rigorous benchmark for measuring long-horizon visual reasoning in agents.
blocks.zh: 虽然语言模型代理人在长视野编码和终端任务方面表现优异,但这一成功取决于两个条件:明确的文本规格和即时执行反馈. 然而,在只有图像中存在关键信息的现实世界问题中,这两个条件都不存在,因此,长期视距能力是否从文本转移到视觉推理方面尚不明确。 在这种视觉环境中,由于规则和线索抵制文本抄录,缺乏测试案例反馈,代理商必须反复检查图像,模拟空间变换,并自主检查线索. 尽管存在这一挑战,但现有的评价未能抓住这种能力:视觉推理基准在很大程度上将任务减少到单回合、短链问题回答,而代理基准则侧重于文本环境或允许审判和错误的互动状态。 为了弥合这一差距,我们引入了Visual Cipher Beaching, 这是一个包含40个原始视觉谜题的集合,它们跨越四个类别:空间操纵和模拟,逻辑约束和规划,规则诱导,以及基于知识的解码. 每个谜题仅提供一至三幅黑白线条图和最低限度的提交指令,要求代理完全从图像中发现基础解析机制. 8个前沿模型的29个推理-努力配置,甚至最强的模型GPT-6 Astra(最大),精确度仅达到26.7%,而8个模型中的5个得分低于1%. 然而,在一个十大任务子集中,提供单一的非破坏机制提示将精度从7.8%提高到55.6%。 这种尖锐的对比表明,当前代理人的主要瓶颈不在于执行多步骤计划,而在于自主地从视觉证据中发现规则. 视觉密码 因此,法官为衡量代理人的长视距视觉推理提供了严格的基准。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Language-model agents have achieved remarkable long-horizon reasoning in coding and terminal tasks: on benchmarks such as SWE-Bench Pro and Terminal-Bench, they autonomously resolve complex issues by iteratively running tests, reading error logs, and revising their plans [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 ] . This success, however, rests on two critical conditions: task specifications are explicitly provided as readable text or code, and execution results immediately signal whether the current trajectory is correct. In many real-world problems, critical information exists only in images. Although frontier models possess foundational visual perception [ 5 , 6 , 7 ] and can invoke tools to crop, annotate, and transform images during reasoning [ 8 , 9 , 10 ] , it remains unclear whether long-horizon reasoning capability truly transfers from text to the visual domain.
blocks.zh: 语言模型代理在编码和终端任务上实现了出众的长视距推理:在SWE-Bench Pro和Terminal-Bench等基准上,他们通过迭接运行测试,读取出出错日志,以及修改他们的计划[1,2,3,4],自主地解决了复杂的问题. 然而,这一成功取决于两个关键条件:任务规格明确作为可读文本或代码提供,执行结果立即表明当前轨迹是否正确. 在许多现实世界的问题中,关键信息只存在于图像中. 虽然边疆模型具有基础视觉感知[5,6,7],并且可以引用工具来收割,注释,并在推理过程中转换图像[8,9,10],但是,长视推理能力是否真正地从文本转移到视觉领域仍然不清楚.

blocks.en: The visual setting is uniquely challenging because neither condition holds. First, rules, examples, and clues are embedded in static images that resist direct text transcription, while multimodal models still falter on basic perceptual judgments [ 11 , 12 , 13 ] . Second, the environment provides no test-case feedback during problem solving, forcing agents to validate hypotheses solely by cross-checking internal visual clues. Consider folding a symbol-marked cube net: even after correctly computing face adjacencies, the solver must still determine the starting face and reading order by re-examining the image for subtle cues. Without external verification, an agent can easily halt after a locally valid step or prematurely commit to a flawed rule simply because a few decoded letters resemble a word. Consequently, long-horizon visual reasoning cannot be reduced to a single pass; it requires agents to iteratively cycle between visual inspection and hypothesis testing—proposing rules, verifying them against global visual constraints, and discarding false assumptions until converging on a unique solution.
blocks.zh: 视觉环境具有独特的挑战性,因为条件都不具备。 首先,规则,实例,和线索被嵌入了静态图像中,无法抵抗直接的文本抄录,而多模式模型在基本概念判断上仍然动摇 [11, 12, 13]. 其次,环境在解决问题期间不提供测试案例反馈,迫使代理仅仅通过交叉检查内部视觉线索来验证假设. 考虑将一个符号标记的立方网折叠:即使在正确计算出面相相辅后,解析器仍然必须通过重新审视图像来决定取出微妙提示的起始面相和读取顺序. 如果没有外部核查,一个代理人就很容易在本地有效的步骤之后就停止,或者仅仅因为几个已解码的字母类似一个单词就过早地承诺遵守一个有缺陷的规则. 因此,长视距的视觉推理不能简化为一通;它要求代理人在视觉检查和假想测试之间进行反复循环——提出规则,对照全球视觉限制加以核实,抛弃假想,直到达成一个独特的解决办法。

blocks.en: Existing evaluations fail to capture this capability. Standard visual reasoning benchmarks reduce problem solving to single-turn question answering with explicitly defined tasks [ 14 , 15 , 16 , 17 , 18 ] . Even when benchmarks incorporate abstract reasoning or spatial simulation, their fixed task formats already telegraph where the underlying rule lies [ 19 , 20 , 21 ] . Meanwhile, agent benchmarks focus predominantly on text and code environments [ 22 , 23 , 24 ] . When these benchmarks do involve vision, images either serve merely as targets for GUI localization or appear in interactive environments that return a new state after every action, allowing agents to rely on trial-and-error rather than pure visual deduction [ 25 , 26 , 27 , 28 ] . Consequently, the field lacks a dedicated benchmark for evaluating long-horizon reasoning over static visual evidence.
blocks.zh: 现有评价未能掌握这一能力。 标准视觉推理基准将解决问题减少为单回合回答问题,并明确提出任务[14、15、16、17、18]。 即使基准包括抽象推理或空间模拟,其固定任务格式已经包含有基本规则的电报[19、20、21]。 同时,代理基准主要侧重于文本和代码环境[22、23、24]。 当这些基准确实涉及愿景时,图像要么只是作为图形用户界面本地化的目标,要么出现在每次行动后返回新状态的互动环境中,使代理商能够依赖试验和过度,而不是纯粹的视觉推理[25、26、27、28]。 因此,外地缺乏一个专门基准,用以评价长视距推理而不是静态视觉证据。

blocks.en:
To bridge this gap, we introduce Visual Cipher Bench (Figure 1 ). Visual puzzles are an ideal testbed for long-horizon visual reasoning: with all rules and clues concealed in the graphics, solvers must uncover the mechanism themselves, as each discovery dictates what to inspect and deduce next [ 29 , 30 ] .
The benchmark comprises 40 original, expert-verified puzzles across four categories: spatial manipulation and simulation, logical constraints and planning, rule induction, and knowledge-based decoding. Each puzzle provides only one to three black-and-white line drawings and a minimal submission instruction. Agents have 60 minutes in an offline coding sandbox to solve each puzzle and are graded strictly by exact match on the final answer, while hidden walkthroughs and reference solvers ensure solvability and enable process auditing.
blocks.zh:
为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了Visual Cipher Beach(图1). 视觉谜题是长相视觉推理的理想试验板:由于图形中隐藏了所有规则和线索,解谜者必须自己揭开机制,因为每次发现都决定了下一步[29,30]检查和推断什么.
该基准包括40个原始的、经过专家验证的谜题,分为四类:空间操纵和模拟、逻辑制约和规划、规则诱导和以知识为基础的解码。 每个谜题只提供一至三幅黑白行图和最低限度的提交指令. 特工们在一个离线编码沙盒里有60分钟的时间来解决每个谜题,并在最终答案上严格按照精确的匹配进行分级,而隐藏的行走道和参考解析器则确保了可溶性并允许过程审计.

blocks.en: We systematically evaluate 29 reasoning-effort configurations across eight frontier models [ 31 , 32 , 33 ] , conducting three independent runs per configuration. Even the strongest configuration, GPT-6 Astra (max), achieves only 26.7% accuracy, while five of the eight models score below 1% in their best configurations. Moreover, performance is heavily skewed across categories: pooled accuracy reaches 22.8% on spatial manipulation and simulation, where transformation rules are visually explicit, but drops to just 0.6% on rule induction. Yet on a ten-task subset spanning all four categories, providing a single non-spoiler mechanism hint boosts accuracy from 7.8% to 55.6% and cuts timeouts from 51 to 18 under the same time limit. This sharp contrast demonstrates that the primary bottleneck of current agents lies not in executing multi-step plans, but in autonomously inducing rules from visual evidence.
blocks.zh: 我们系统评价了跨越八个前沿模型的29个推理-努力配置[31,32,33],每个配置进行3个独立运行. 即使是最强的配置,GPT-6 Astra(最大)也只达到26.7%的精度,而8个模型中有5个在最佳配置中得分低于1%. 此外,各类别的业绩严重扭曲:在空间操纵和模拟中,组合精度达到22.8%,其中转换规则是直观的,但在规则诱导中则降至0.6%。 然而,在一个涵盖所有四类的十大任务子集中,提供单一的非破坏机制提示将精确度从7.8%提高到55.6%,在同一时限内将暂停时间从51个减少到18个。 这种尖锐的对比表明,当前代理人的主要瓶颈不在于执行多步骤计划,而在于从视觉证据中自主地诱导规则.

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold: • We introduce Visual Cipher Bench, a long-horizon visual reasoning benchmark of 40 original puzzles that embeds all rules and clues exclusively within static images and provides no intermediate feedback during solving. • We benchmark 29 reasoning-effort configurations across eight frontier models, exposing a stark capability ceiling: even the top-performing agent solves barely a quarter of the tasks, while most frontier models fail almost completely. • We pinpoint the core bottleneck of visual agents through mechanism-hint ablations and trajectory audits, demonstrating that agents fail primarily at inducing rules and constraints from visual evidence rather than executing multi-step plans.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献有三: 我们引入了Visual Cipher Beach,一个由40个原始谜题组成的长视距视觉推理基准,将所有规则和线索完全嵌入到静态图像中,在解析过程中不提供中间反馈. ^ 我们以29个推理-努力配置为基准,跨越了8个前沿模型,暴露出一个严峻的能力上限:即使是顶级代理也只解决了四分之一的任务,而大多数前沿模型几乎完全失败. ^ . 我们通过机制缺陷和轨迹审计,确定视觉代理人的核心瓶颈,表明代理人主要未能从视觉证据中诱导规则和制约,而不是执行多步骤计划。

blocks.en: We introduce Visual Cipher Bench, a long-horizon visual reasoning benchmark of 40 original puzzles that embeds all rules and clues exclusively within static images and provides no intermediate feedback during solving.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了Visual Cipher Beach,一个由40个原始谜题组成的长视距视觉推理基准,将所有规则和线索完全嵌入到静态图像中,在解析过程中不提供中间反馈.

blocks.zh: 我们以29个推理-努力配置为基准,跨越了8个前沿模型,暴露出一个严峻的能力上限:即使是顶级的代理也只解决了四分之一的任务,而大多数前沿模型几乎完全失败.

blocks.en: We pinpoint the core bottleneck of visual agents through mechanism-hint ablations and trajectory audits, demonstrating that agents fail primarily at inducing rules and constraints from visual evidence rather than executing multi-step plans.
blocks.zh: 我们通过机制缺陷和轨迹审计,确定视觉代理人的核心瓶颈,表明代理人主要未能从视觉证据中诱导规则和制约,而不是执行多步骤计划。

blocks.en: 2.2 Benchmark Design and Composition
blocks.zh: 2.2 基准设计和组成

blocks.en: We surveyed hundreds of public puzzle resources, including past puzzle-competition problems, solver write-ups, and authoring guides [ 29 , 30 ] , and designed the puzzles according to two principles. The first is solvability: every key inference is supported by evidence on the puzzle page, the clues suffice to determine a unique answer, and solvers need neither guesswork nor hints from outside the puzzle. The second is long-horizon reasoning: the answer cannot be read off in a single step; solvers must first discover the mechanism, then work through multiple interdependent steps and check earlier inferences against later clues, and the answer cannot be guessed from local clues or thematic association alone. The former ensures puzzle quality; the latter ensures difficulty.
blocks.zh: 我们调查了数百个公开的谜题资源,包括过去的谜题竞争问题,解题写作,以及作者指南[29,30],并根据两个原则设计了谜题. 第一种是可解性:每个密钥推论都得到谜题页面上的证据支持,线索足以确定一个独特的答案,解题者既不需要猜想工作,也不需要谜题外的提示. 二是长相推理:答案不能单步读出;解题者必须先发现机制,再通过多个相互依存的步骤来工作,并对照后期线索来检查更早的推论,答案不能单从本地线索或主题关联中猜出. 前者确保谜题的质量;后者确保困难。

blocks.en: All 40 puzzles are original to this benchmark. Each puzzle was designed together with a complete solution, consisting of a step-by-step walkthrough and a reference solver: the former records the visual evidence behind each key step, and the latter reproduces the reference answer using only the puzzle images. Every puzzle was reviewed by human experts, who confirmed that the solution path is sound, the visual evidence is sufficient, and the answer is unique. Neither material is provided to evaluated agents.
blocks.zh: 所有40个谜题都是这个基准的原创. 每个谜题的设计与一个完整的解决方案一起,包括一个分步走法和一个参考解析器:前者记录每个关键步骤背后的视觉证据,而后者只使用谜题图像来复制参考解答. 每个谜题都经过了人类专家的审查,他们确认解决方案路径是健全的,视觉证据是充分的,答案是独一无二的. 没有向受评价的代理人提供材料。

blocks.en: We categorize puzzles along two dimensions: whether the main difficulty lies in executing an identified mechanism or in discovering which mechanism to use, and whether solving relies mainly on rule-constrained reasoning or on visual imagination and knowledge association. Combining the two dimensions yields four primary categories; each puzzle belongs to one category, and each category contains 10 puzzles (Figure 1 ): • P1 Spatial manipulation and simulation: simulate the state after operations such as folding, rotation, and projection; • P2 Logical constraints and planning: carry out derivations under grid, path, or state constraints; • P3 Rule induction: induce a puzzle-specific rule or cipher from examples within the puzzle; • P4 Knowledge-based decoding: recognize the external convention indicated by the visual clues, such as Morse code, Braille, or wordplay, and decode accordingly.
blocks.zh: 我们把谜题分为两个方面:主要困难是执行一个确定的机制,还是发现使用哪种机制,以及解决主要依靠规则限制的推理还是视觉想象和知识关联. 将两个维度合并产生四个主要类别;每个谜题属于一个类别,每个类别包含10个谜题(图1): • P1空间操纵和模拟:在折叠,旋转等操作后模拟状态,并进行投影; • P2逻辑约束和规划:在网格,路径或状态约束下进行衍生; • P3规则诱导:从谜题内的例子中诱导出一个针对谜题的规则或密码; • P4知识解码:识别可视线索所显示的外部常规,如摩尔斯码,盲文,或文字游戏,并相应解码.

blocks.en: P1 Spatial manipulation and simulation: simulate the state after operations such as folding, rotation, and projection;
blocks.zh: P1 空间操纵和模拟:模拟折叠、旋转和投影等操作后的状态;

blocks.en: P2 Logical constraints and planning: carry out derivations under grid, path, or state constraints;
blocks.zh: P2 逻辑制约和规划:在网格、路径或状态制约下进行衍生;

blocks.en: P3 Rule induction: induce a puzzle-specific rule or cipher from examples within the puzzle;
blocks.zh: P3规则诱导:从谜中的实例中诱导出一个特定谜题规则或密码;

blocks.en: P4 Knowledge-based decoding: recognize the external convention indicated by the visual clues, such as Morse code, Braille, or wordplay, and decode accordingly.
blocks.zh: P4 基于知识的解码:识别视觉线索所显示的外部常规,如摩斯码,盲文,或文字游戏等,并相应解码.

blocks.en: The 40 tasks contain 67 images, all drawn as black-and-white line art in a consistent style: 19 single-image tasks, 15 two-image tasks, and six three-image tasks. Reference answers range from 4 to 30 characters. Twenty-eight are English words or phrases; the other 12 include digit strings, letter codes, and related sequences for which the exact characters and their order must be preserved.
blocks.zh: 40个任务包含67个图像,均以一致的风格被绘制为黑白线条艺术:19个单相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 参考答案从4到30个字符不等. 二十八是英文单词或词组;其他十二个包括数字字符串,字母代码,以及相关的序列,必须保留确切的字符及其顺序.

blocks.en: 3 Experiments
blocks.zh: 3个实验

blocks.en: 3.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate eight models: Claude Opus 5.5 [ 36 ] , Claude Sonnet 5.5 [ 37 ] , GPT-6.1 Sol [ 38 ] , GPT-6 Astra [ 39 ] , GPT-6 Luna [ 40 ] , DeepSeek V4.1 Flash [ 41 ] , Qwen 3.8 Max [ 42 ] , and Kimi K3.1 Pro [ 43 ] . Depending on the interfaces available for each model, we evaluate one or more reasoning-effort levels, yielding 29 model–effort configurations. Every configuration is run independently three times on all 40 tasks, for 87 complete benchmark runs and 3,480 task-level attempts.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了八个模式: Claude Opus 5.5 [36], Claude Sonnet 5.5 [37], GPT-6.1 Sol [38], GPT-6 Astra [39], GPT-6 Luna [40], DeepSeek V4.1 Flash [41], Quen 3.8 Max [42],和 Kimi K3.1 Pro [43]. 根据每个模型可用的接口,我们评价一个或多个推理-努力级别,得出29个模型-努力配置. 每个配置在所有40项任务中独立运行了3次,其中87项是完整的基准运行,3 480项是任务级别的尝试。

blocks.en: The evaluation protocol follows Section 2.1 ; the runtime harness, time limit, and compute resources are listed in Appendix A . We report two metrics:
blocks.zh: 评价协议遵循第2.1节;运行时间、时限和计算资源列于附录A。 我们报告两个标准:

blocks.en: 1. Mean accuracy: accuracy over the 120 attempts of a configuration across three runs (Eq. ( 2 )); Table 1 also reports the corresponding mean number of tasks solved per run (Mean /40). 2. Category accuracy: computed in the same way for each of the four categories (spatial manipulation and simulation, logical constraints and planning, rule induction, and knowledge-based decoding) over the 30 attempts per category.
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 平均准确性:精确度超过120次对三跑的配置尝试(Eq. (2));表1还报告了每跑完成的相应平均任务数(Mean 40)。 2. 类别准确性:每类30次尝试(空间操纵和模拟、逻辑制约和规划、规则诱导和知识解码)以同样方式计算。

blocks.en: Mean accuracy: accuracy over the 120 attempts of a configuration across three runs (Eq. ( 2 )); Table 1 also reports the corresponding mean number of tasks solved per run (Mean /40).
blocks.zh: 平均准确性:精确度超过120次对三跑的配置尝试(Eq. (2));表1还报告了每跑完成的相应平均任务数(Mean 40)。

blocks.en: Category accuracy: computed in the same way for each of the four categories (spatial manipulation and simulation, logical constraints and planning, rule induction, and knowledge-based decoding) over the 30 attempts per category.
blocks.zh: 类别准确性:每类30次尝试中,每类(空间操纵和模拟、逻辑制约和规划、规则诱导和以知识为基础的解码)以同样方式计算。

blocks.en: 3.2 Overall Performance
blocks.zh: 3.2 总体业绩

blocks.en: Table 1 : Results of all 29 configurations on Visual Cipher Bench, with models ordered by their best configuration. P1–P4 give the category accuracy over the 30 attempts in each category, Acc. gives the mean accuracy over all 120 attempts, and Mean gives the corresponding number of tasks solved per run (out of 40). All values average three runs; the best value in each column is in bold. Each model’s best configuration is shaded.
blocks.zh: 表1:视觉Cipher座椅上所有29个配置的结果,模型按其最佳配置订购. P1–P4给出了每类中30个尝试的分类准确性,Acc.给出了所有120个尝试的平均值准确性,Mean给出了每跑(共40个)所解决的相应任务数量. 所有值平均为3个;每列中的最佳值为粗体. 每个模型的最佳配置被遮蔽.

blocks.en: Table 1 lists all 29 configurations, with models ordered by their best configuration; below we compare models by their best configurations. GPT-6 Astra (max) performs best, solving 10.7 of 40 tasks per run on average, an accuracy of 26.7%; GPT-6.1 Sol (max) and Claude Opus 5.5 (xhigh) tie for second at 8.7/40 (21.7%). No configuration reaches 30%: even the best configuration leaves about three quarters of the tasks unsolved on average. In terms of category accuracy, the leading configurations score almost entirely on spatial manipulation and simulation: GPT-6 Astra (max) reaches 80.0% there, whereas no configuration exceeds 13.3% on any of the other three categories.
blocks.zh: 表1列出了所有29个配置,模型按其最佳配置顺序排列;下方我们按其最佳配置比较模型. GPT-6 Astra(最大)性能最佳,平均每跑40个任务中解决10.7个,精度为26.7%;GPT-6.1 Sol(最大)和克洛德·奥普斯(克洛德·奥普斯·5.5(x高)接头为8.7/40(21.7%). 没有配置达到30%:即使最好的配置也平均留下约四分之三的任务未解决. 在分类准确度方面,领先配置几乎完全靠空间操纵和模拟得分:GPT-6 Astra(最大)在那里达到80.0%,而其他三个类别中任何一个配置都不超过13.3%。

blocks.en: The remaining five models lag far behind. GPT-6 Luna and Claude Sonnet 5.5 solve only 0.3 of 40 tasks per run in their best configurations, that is, a single correct answer across three runs, while DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, Qwen 3.8 Max, and Kimi K3.1 Pro solve no task in any of their three runs. The models therefore split sharply: the best configurations of the top three models solve 8.7 to 10.7 tasks per run, the other five solve almost none, and nothing lies in between. Visual Cipher Bench is thus far from saturated and clearly separates frontier models.
blocks.zh: 其余5个型号远远落后. GPT-6 Luna和Claude Sonnet 5.5在最佳配置中只解决了每跑40个任务的0.3个,即一个跨越3个跑道的正确答案,而DeepSeek V4.1 Flash,Quen 3.8 Max,和Kimi K3.1 Pro在他们的三跑中都没有解决任何任务. 因此,模型急剧分化:前三个模型的最佳配置每跑解决了8.7到10.7个任务,而其他五个则几乎无一解决,没有什么在两者之间. 视觉密码 座椅远非饱和,而且明显地将前沿模型分开。

blocks.en: 3.3 Analysis of Agent Performance
blocks.zh: 3.3 物剂性能分析

blocks.en: 3.3.1 Rule Discovery Is the Main Bottleneck
blocks.zh: 3.3.1 规则发现 是主瓶锁

blocks.en: Pooling the 3,480 attempts of all 29 configurations by category, spatial manipulation and simulation reaches 22.8% accuracy, whereas knowledge-based decoding, logical constraints and planning, and rule induction reach only 3.3%, 2.4%, and 0.6%; the three leading models share the same profile (Table 1 ). In spatial tasks, the operations are usually given in the images, and the difficulty lies in executing a multi-step transformation correctly; rule-induction tasks instead require discovering a task-specific rule from a few examples. The latter are almost never solved: only 5 of 870 attempts are correct, and some of these trajectories show that the model never recovered the rule and guessed the answer only because its letters formed a theme-related word. Logic tasks are also low because they require large searches under constraints; Section 3.3.2 shows that agents on these tasks often replace pruning with exhaustive enumeration.
blocks.zh: 将所有29个配置的3,480次尝试按类别、空间操纵和模拟组合到22.8%的准确度,而基于知识的解码、逻辑制约和规划以及规则诱导只达到3.3%、2.4%和0.6%;三大模型具有相同的特征(表1)。 在空间任务中,操作通常是在图像中给出的,困难在于正确执行多步转换;而规则引入任务则需要从几个例子中发现一个任务特定规则. 后者几乎从未被解决:870个尝试中只有5个是正确的,其中一些轨迹显示模型从未恢复过规则并猜出答案,仅仅是因为其字母形成了一个与主题相关的词. 逻辑任务也很低,因为它们在限制下需要大范围搜索; 第3.3.2节显示,执行这些任务的代理人往往会用详尽的列举来取而代之。

blocks.en: Table 2 : Mechanism-hint ablation: accuracy (%) on the ten selected tasks. The upper block reports each model; the lower block pools the three models by category. Each model runs each task three times.
blocks.zh: 表2:机制作用:十个选定任务的准确性(%)。 上区块报告每个模型;下区块按类别将三个模型集合. 每个模型运行每个任务三次.

blocks.en: Category differences, however, are only correlational: the four categories differ in many ways beyond whether the rule is visible. To test directly whether rule discovery is the bottleneck, we run a mechanism-hint ablation. We randomly select ten tasks across the four categories and give each a one-sentence mechanism hint that names the intended state representation and core update mechanism without revealing intermediate states or the final answer. GPT-6 Astra (max), GPT-6.1 Sol (max), and GPT-6 Luna (max) each run every task three times, and we compare them with unhinted runs of the same configurations.
blocks.zh: 然而,类别差异只是关联性的:这四个类别在许多方面不同,超出了规则是否可见. 为了直接测试规则的发现是否为瓶颈,我们运行了一种机制闪烁. 我们随机地在四类中选择了十项任务,并给每一个一个单一判决机制提示,命名意图状态的代表和核心更新机制而不透露中间状态或最终答案. GPT-6 Astra (max),GPT-6.1 Sol (max),和GPT-6 Luna (max) 每一个任务运行三次,我们将它们与相同配置的未闪出运行相比较.

blocks.en: Table 2 reports the results. Mechanism hints raise overall accuracy from 7.8% to 55.6%, and both leading models rise from about 10% to about 75%. The largest gain is in rule induction (3.7% → \rightarrow 81.5%), the hardest category without hints. Under the same time limit, timeouts also fall from 51 to 18. Once the rule is known, the leading models can largely carry out the remaining multi-step reasoning; the bottleneck is discovering the rule from visual evidence. The weaker GPT-6 Luna improves only from 0 to 16.7%, indicating that for weaker models execution itself remains an obstacle.
blocks.zh: 表2汇报了结果。 机理提示将总体精度从7.8%提高到55.6%,而两种主要模型都从10%左右上升到了75%左右. 最大的收益是在规则诱导(3.7% ~\右旋81.5%),最难的类别没有提示. 在同一时限内,超时时间也从51个降至18个。 一旦规则被知道,领先的模型基本上可以进行剩余的多步骤推理;瓶颈是从视觉证据中发现规则的. 较弱的GPT-6 Luna只提高从0到16.7%,表明对于较弱的模型执行本身仍然是一个障碍.

blocks.en: 3.3.2 Failure Modes
blocks.zh: 3.3.2 失败模式

blocks.en: Unsolved attempts end in one of two main ways: the agent submits a wrong answer, or it does not finish within the 60-minute limit. We manually audit representative wrong-answer and timeout trajectories and analyse their causes against the puzzle, the walkthrough, and the reference solver.
blocks.zh: 未解决的尝试以两种主要方式之一结束:代理提交错误的答案,或者在60分钟的限制内没有完成. 我们手动审计代表错误的回答和超时的轨迹,并对照谜题,走过和参考解析器分析其原因.

blocks.en: Most wrong answers are not computational slips: the agent does not test its hypothesis against evidence already on the page. Most often, once it finds a rule that explains some of the examples, it answers without checking the rule against the remaining examples or the global constraints. When the rule stays unresolved, agents also tend to abandon induction and submit an answer that fits the puzzle’s theme but is not supported by the examples, sometimes even while acknowledging that the answer is incomplete. By contrast, trajectories that find the correct mechanism but err in transcription or execution are less common. Successful trajectories do the opposite: they write several candidate rules, turn every example into an assertion to filter them, and only then work out the targets. The examples in a puzzle are themselves test cases, and agents that answer wrongly rarely make full use of them.
blocks.zh: 大多数错误的答案不是计算滑动:代理商不测试其假说与已经存在于页面上的证据相比. 最常见的是,一旦它找到一条解释一些例子的规则,它就会回答,而不对照所剩的例子或全球的制约检查规则. 当规则仍未解决时,代理商也倾向于放弃诱导并提交一个符合谜题主题但没有得到实例支持的答案,有时甚至承认答案不完整. 相比之下,找到正确机制但在转录或执行中出错的轨迹则不太常见. 成功的轨迹是相反的:他们写出几个候选规则,把每个例子变成一个断言来过滤它们,然后才制定出目标. 谜题中的例子本身就是测试案例,错误回答的代理人很少充分利用.

blocks.en: Trajectories that time out do not lack tool use; the problem is that they spend their compute on enumeration. Some search broadly through generic rule families such as cellular automata and morphological operators, or keep switching among interpretations; these candidates do not come from cues in the images, and the agents write no test that quickly rules them out, so the search space never contracts. Others find the correct mechanism but try every combination of unknown states instead of pruning with the puzzle’s constraints, and cannot finish in time. The hint ablation confirms this from the other side: once a hint narrows the hypothesis space, timeouts fall sharply under the same time limit. Most timeouts therefore reflect not a lack of time but a hypothesis space that the visual evidence never narrowed.
blocks.zh: 超时的轨迹并不缺乏工具使用;问题在于它们把计算用在计数上. 有些人通过一般规则的家族,如蜂窝自体和形态操作员进行广泛的搜索,或者不断在解释中切换;这些候选者并非来自图像中的提示,代理商不会写出快速排除他们的测试,因此搜索空间永远不会收缩. 其他人找到正确的机制,但尝试所有未知状态的组合,而不是玩弄谜题的束缚,无法及时完成。 提示衰减从另一侧证实了这一点:一旦一个提示缩小了假说空间,超时会急剧地落在同一个时间范围内. 因此,大多数超时反映的并不是缺乏时间,而是视觉证据从未缩小的假说空间.

blocks.en: Both failure modes thus point to the same deficiency: agents rarely use visual evidence to constrain their hypotheses. Wrong answers use only part of the evidence; timeouts rely on enumeration rather than evidence to narrow the search.
blocks.zh: 因此两种故障模式都指向了相同的缺陷:代理商很少使用视觉证据来约束他们的假设. 错误的答案只使用部分证据;超时依赖于列举而不是证据来缩小搜索.

blocks.en: 3.4 Benchmark Validation
blocks.zh: 3.4 基准验证

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Solving Closed Stock (knowledge-based decoding). (a) Seal 03 points to a horn on page I and to a box on page II; both SHOE and POST satisfy these two local clues. (b) Seal 10 takes part in five compounds, and only STONE satisfies all of them, fixing seals 10, 04, and 08. (c) RETURN requires the 15 words to form a closed loop of compounds; only one such loop exists, and it also rules out POST. Reading the seal numbers from 01 gives the answer. Icons are taken from the puzzle; the full puzzle is shown in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 图2:解决已关闭股票(基于知识的解码)。 (a) 第03章指一页上的一个角和二页上的一个盒子;SHOE和POST都满足了这两个本地线索. (b) 封条10参与五个化合物,只有STONE满足所有化合物,固定封条10、04和08。 (c) ReturnN要求15个单词组成一个封闭的化合物循环;只有一个这样的循环存在,它也排除了POST. 从01读取封号给出答案. 图标取自谜题;完整谜题在附录B中显示.

blocks.en: 3.4.1 Reliability and Solvability
blocks.zh: 3.4.1 可靠性和可解性

blocks.en: Grading in Visual Cipher Bench is deterministic exact matching: the same submission always receives the same score, so randomness in the evaluation comes only from the agent’s solving process. We therefore run each model–effort configuration independently three times on all 40 tasks and report the mean accuracy over the three runs, in line with recommendations to account for sampling variability in model evaluations [ 44 ] .
blocks.zh: Visual Cipher Beachs中的分数是精确的匹配:同样的提交总是得到相同的分数,因此评价中的随机性只来自代理的解析过程. 因此,我们按照在模型评价中考虑到抽样可变性的建议,在所有40项任务上独立运行每个模型3次,并报告三个运行的平均准确性[44]。

blocks.en: Every task comes with a step-by-step walkthrough and a reference solver. The walkthrough records the visual evidence, rule, and disambiguation behind each key step, and the reference solver reproduces the reference answer from the puzzle images alone. An oracle agent that runs the reference solver passes the grader on all 40 tasks. In addition, two human experts reviewed every task and its walkthrough, confirming that the visual evidence suffices to derive the answer, that every step of the walkthrough is sound, and that the answer is unique; all 40 tasks passed the review.
blocks.zh: 每个任务都有一个分步走法和参考解析器。 行走记录了每个关键步骤背后的视觉证据,规则,和分化,参考解析器只从谜题图像中复制了参考解答. 运行参考解析器的甲骨文代理在所有40个任务上都会通过分级. 此外,两位人类专家审查了每一项任务及其走过,确认视觉证据足以得出答案,走过的每一步都是有道理的,答案是独特的;所有40个任务都通过了审查.

blocks.en: 3.4.2 Case Study: Closed Stock
blocks.zh: 3.4.2 案例研究:封闭库存

blocks.en: We use Closed Stock, a knowledge-based decoding task (Figure 2 ; full puzzle in Appendix B ), to show how a puzzle satisfies both design principles, solvability and long-horizon reasoning; this category reaches only 3.3% accuracy across all configurations. The puzzle is a two-page register in which 15 numbered seals and several pictured objects are linked by arrows. The same seal number appears repeatedly across both pages, yet the register gives each number a single blank, so each number must take one word; at the bottom, a RETURN chain of 15 empty circles winds through three rows and back to 01. The solver must infer the mechanism unaided: two items joined by an arrow form a common English compound, and the 15 words must also chain into a closed loop.
blocks.zh: 我们使用基于知识的解码任务(图2;附录B中的完整谜题)Commerd Stock来显示一个谜题如何满足设计原则、可溶性和长视距推理;这个类别在所有配置中都只达到3.3%。 拼图是一个两页的寄存器,其中15个被编号的封条和几个被描绘出的对象由箭头相接. 同一封号在两页之间反复出现,然而收存器却给每个号码一个单空,所以每个号码必须取出一字;在下方,一个由15个空圆风组成的回旋链通过三行并回回到01. 解题者必须推断无辅助机制:由一箭相接的两个项目组成了共同的英语复合体,而15个单词也必须连入一个闭环.

blocks.en: Solving proceeds through three layers of constraints. First, local clues are ambiguous (Figure 2 a): seal 03 points to a horn on page I and to a box on page II, and both SHOE (SHOEHORN, SHOEBOX) and POST (POSTHORN, POSTBOX) satisfy the two clues. Second, crossing clues fix some seals (Figure 2 b): seal 10 is linked to the horn, a fly, an axe, and seals 04 and 08, and only STONE satisfies all five compounds HORNSTONE, STONEFLY, STONE AXE, STONEFISH, and STONEWARE, which fixes seals 10, 04, and 08 as STONE, FISH, and WARE; the constraints then propagate across pages, for instance WAREHOUSE fixes seal 01 as HOUSE. Finally, the global loop yields a unique answer (Figure 2 c): several seals still admit multiple candidates at this point (seal 02 may be MILL or WATER, seal 07 WIND, AIR, or MAIL, and seal 03 is still SHOE or POST), but only one loop links all 15 words end to end, HOUSE–BOAT–RACE–HORSE–SHOE–STRING–BEAN–POLE–CAT–FISH–TAIL–WIND–MILL–STONE–WARE, and its links HORSESHOE and SHOESTRING settle seal 03 as SHOE. Reading the seal numbers from 01 gives the answer 011205140309150611041307021008 .
blocks.zh: 由三层束缚解决 首先,本地线索模糊不清(图2 a):封号03指一页上的一个角和二页上的一个盒子,而SHOE(SHOHORN,SHOEBOX)和POST(POSTHORN,POSTBOX)都满足了这两个线索. 第二,交叉线索固定了一些封条(图2b):封条10与角、一只苍蝇、一把斧子和封条04和08相接,只有STONE满足了所有五个化合物HORNSTONE、STONEFLY、STONE AXE、STONEFISH和STONEWARE,它们将封条10、04和08作为STONE、FISH和WARE相接;这些限制随后跨越了各页,例如WAREHONE将封条01作为住宅。 最后,环球环路产生一个独特的答案(图2 c):有几条海豹此时仍然接纳多个候选者(封地02可以是MILL或水,封地07 WIND,AIR,或MIL,而封地03仍然是SHOE或POST),但只有一条环路链接所有15个字都到尾端,房子-BOAT-RACE-HORS-HORS-BOLE-POLE-POLE-POLE-FISH-TAIL-WIND-MALL-STONE-WARE,其链接HORESHOE和SHOESTRING 结算封地03作为SHOE. 从01读取封号给出了答案011205140309150611041307021008.

blocks.en: The puzzle embodies both design principles. It is solvable: every inference is supported by the puzzle page, less common compounds such as HORNSTONE and MILLRACE are each cross-confirmed by several familiar ones, and the final answer is unique. It also requires long-horizon reasoning: no single clue reveals the answer, and the solver must propagate constraints across two pages, hold ambiguities open, and finally check every choice against the global loop. Agent behaviour bears this out. The successful Claude Opus 5.5 trajectory keeps local ambiguities open and uses the complete loop to fix the order, matching the reference solution.
blocks.zh: 谜题体现了两个设计原则. 其可解:每个推论都由谜题页所支持,HORNSTONE和MILLRACE等不太常见的复合物每个被几个熟悉的被交叉确认,最后的答案是独一无二的. 这也需要长相的推理:没有一条线索能揭示答案,解题者必须传播出两页的制约,保持模糊不清的开口,最后对照全球循环来检查每一个选择. 代理行为证实了这一点。 成功的克洛德·奥普斯 5.5轨迹保持了局部模糊的开口,并使用完整的回路来固定顺序,匹配了参考解决方案.

blocks.en: 4 Related Work
blocks.zh: 4 相关工作

blocks.en: Visual reasoning benchmarks. Most visual reasoning benchmarks evaluate image understanding through a given question. MMMU [ 14 ] and MMMU-Pro [ 16 ] require models to interpret charts and diagrams in exam questions using subject knowledge, while MathVista [ 15 ] and MathVerse [ 17 ] test whether models can extract quantitative and geometric relations from images to answer mathematical questions. Perception probes show that multimodal models still err on judgments that humans make at a glance [ 11 , 12 , 13 ] . For spatial simulation, mental-rotation experiments show that humans mentally simulate transformations of figures [ 45 ] , and STARE [ 21 ] evaluates multi-step visual simulation in tasks such as folding cube nets. Rule induction forms another line: Raven’s Progressive Matrices [ 46 ] and their procedurally generated counterpart RAVEN [ 19 ] ask solvers to complete a pattern matrix, while ARC [ 47 ] and ARC-AGI-2 [ 20 ] require inferring grid transformations from a few input–output examples. Models can propose natural-language hypotheses and implement them as programs for testing [ 48 ] , yet high accuracy does not imply that the intended abstraction has been acquired [ 49 ] , and part of the difficulty on visual inputs stems from perception rather than induction [ 50 ] . In these benchmarks, the question or task format specifies the task, and the reasoning chains are short. Visual Cipher Bench provides no such framing: the agent must determine from the images which graphics are examples and which mechanism to apply.
blocks.zh: 视觉推理基准. 大多数视觉推理基准通过特定的问题来评价图像理解. MMMU [14]和MMMU-Pro [16] 要求模型在考试问题中使用科目知识来解释图表和图表,而MathVista [15]和MathVerse [17]测试模型是否能够从图像中提取出定量和几何关系来回答数学问题. 认知探测器显示,多模式模型仍然在人类一目了然[11,12,13]的判断上出错. 对于空间模拟,精神旋转实验显示人类的心能模拟数字的转变[45],而STARE [21]在折叠立方网等任务中评价多步视觉模拟. 规则诱导形成另一行:Raven的进取母体[46]及其程序生成的对应方RAVEN[19]要求解决者完成一个图案矩阵,而ARC[47]和ARC-AGI-2[20]则需要从几个输入-输出实例推断出电网转换。 模型可以提出自然语言假说并将其作为测试程序来实施[48],然而高精度并不意味着预期抽象已经获得[49],视觉输入的部分困难来自于感知而不是诱导[50]. 在这些基准中,问题或任务格式规定了任务,推理链很短. Visual Cipher Beach没有提供这样的框架:代理商必须从图像中确定哪些图形是实例,以及应用何种机制.

blocks.en: Long-horizon agent benchmarks. As reasoning, acting, and tool use have improved [ 51 , 52 , 53 , 54 , 55 ] , language-model agents have become increasingly capable of long-horizon problem solving. The corresponding evaluations focus mainly on text and code tasks: SWE-bench [ 24 ] and SWE-Bench Pro [ 1 ] require resolving issues in real code repositories, Terminal-Bench [ 2 ] requires completing complex command-line tasks, and MLE-bench [ 3 ] , WebArena [ 22 ] , and GAIA [ 23 ] cover machine-learning engineering, web navigation, and general assistant tasks, respectively; meanwhile, the length of tasks that agents can complete autonomously is growing rapidly [ 4 ] . Work on the visual side, by contrast, rarely probes long-horizon reasoning. Visual programming, Visual Sketchpad, and “thinking with images” approaches allow models to crop, annotate, or transform images while reasoning [ 8 , 56 , 9 , 10 , 57 ] , but they are mainly validated on single-turn visual question answering and yield limited gains over direct reasoning [ 58 ] . In graphical-interface tasks such as OSWorld [ 25 ] , images mainly serve localization and operation. Interactive games such as BALROG, LongPuzzleBench, and ARC-AGI-3 require many actions, but the environment returns a new state after every action, so agents can obtain feedback by trial and error rather than reasoning solely from evidence in fixed images [ 26 , 27 , 28 ] . Long-horizon reasoning over fixed visual evidence therefore still lacks a dedicated benchmark.
blocks.zh: 长视特工基准. 由于推理,行为,以及工具的使用都得到了改进[51,52,53,54,55],语言模型代理人越来越能够长距离地解决问题. 相应的评价主要侧重于文本和代码任务: SWE-bench [24]和 SWE-Bench Pro [1] 需要解决真实代码寄存器中的问题, Termin-Bench [2] 需要完成复杂的指令行任务, MLE-bench [3], WebArena [22],和 GAIA [23] 分别涵盖机器学习工程,网络导航,和一般助理任务; 同时,代理能够自主完成的任务长度正在迅速增长 [4]. 相形之下,视觉方面的工作很少能探究出长相的推理. Visual programming,Visual Sketchpad,和"想一想一想一想一想一想"的方法使得模型在推理时可以收缩,注释或转换图像[8,56,9,10,57],但它们主要是在单回合的视觉问题回答上得到验证,并比直接推理获得有限的收益[58]. 在OSWorld等图形界面任务中,图像主要服务于本地化和操作. BALROG,LongPizzle Bench,和ARC-AGI-3等互动游戏需要许多动作,但环境在每次动作后都会返回一个新的状态,因此代理商可以通过试玩和出错获得反馈,而不是仅仅从固定图像中的证据中获得推理[26,27,28]. 因此,对固定视觉证据的长远推理仍然缺乏一个专门的基准。

blocks.en: Puzzles and cipher solving. Puzzles have long been used to study human problem solving: cognitive science has found that breakthroughs often come from restructuring the problem representation rather than from searching harder within it [ 59 , 60 , 61 ] . Puzzles are now also used to evaluate language models: cryptic crosswords [ 62 ] , rebuses [ 63 , 64 ] , and visual riddles [ 65 ] require combining wordplay, graphical layout, and commonsense; shift-cipher experiments show that decoding accuracy varies with how common a shift is in the training data [ 66 ] ; and multimodal puzzle collections cover abstract figures, algorithmic puzzles, and IQ-test-style problems [ 67 , 68 , 69 , 70 , 71 , 72 ] . EnigmaEval [ 73 ] and PuzzleWorld [ 74 ] further use puzzle-competition problems to evaluate open-ended reasoning. However, their puzzles are drawn from existing human puzzle events and mix textual and visual clues, and as models have improved, most of these problems have already been solved. In contrast, all puzzles in Visual Cipher Bench are original, and their rules, examples, and clues exist only in images. Each puzzle is designed under the principles of solvability and long-horizon reasoning and reviewed by human experts to ensure both quality and difficulty; the best configuration currently solves only about a quarter of the puzzles.
blocks.zh: 谜题和密码解析. 谜题早已被用来研究人类问题的解决:认知科学发现,突破往往来自于问题代表结构的调整,而不是在它内部更努力地寻找[59,60,61]. 谜语现在也被用来评价语言模型: 密码填字 [62],再版 [63,64],和视觉谜语 [65] 需要结合文字游戏,图形布局,和常识; 转接密码实验显示,解码精度随训练数据中常见的转变程度而变化 [66]; 多式联运谜语集涵盖抽象数字,算法谜语,以及 IQtest 风格的问题 [67, 68, 69, 70, 71, 72]. EnigmaEval [73]和"谜题世界" [74] 进一步使用谜题-竞争问题来评价开放式推理. 然而,他们的谜题取自现有的人类谜题事件并混合了文字和视觉线索,随着模型的改进,这些问题大多已经解决. 相形之下,Visual Cipher Beach中的所有谜题都是有原创性的,他们的规则,例子,和线索只存在于图像中. 每个谜题的设计遵循可溶性和长相推理的原则,并经过人类专家审查,以确保质量和难度;目前最好的配置只能解决约四分之一的谜题.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented Visual Cipher Bench: 40 original visual puzzles whose rules, examples, and clues all reside in one to three black-and-white line drawings, which agents must solve over an extended period with tools in an offline sandbox and which are scored only by exact match on the final answer. Across 29 reasoning-effort configurations of eight frontier models, the best configuration, GPT-6 Astra (max), solves only 10.7 of 40 tasks on average (26.7%), and five of the eight models solve fewer than one task on average in their best configurations; accuracy reaches 22.8% on spatial manipulation and simulation but only 0.6% on rule induction. On a ten-task subset covering all four categories, a single mechanism hint that does not reveal the answer raises accuracy from 7.8% to 55.6%, indicating that the main weakness of current agents lies not in executing multi-step plans but in discovering the rules from visual evidence on their own. Improving long-horizon visual reasoning therefore hinges on teaching agents to discover rules from images and keep checking them; Visual Cipher Bench provides a reliable benchmark for measuring this capability.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了“视觉塞弗座椅”:40个原始的视觉谜题,其规则、例子和线索都包含在一到三幅黑白线图上, 特工们必须用离线沙盒中的工具在较长的时间内解决这些问题, 并且只有在最后答案上精确地匹配。 8个前沿模型的29个推理-努力配置中,最佳配置为GPT-6 Astra(最大),平均只解决了40个任务中的10.7个(26.7%),8个模型中的5个在最佳配置中平均解决不到1个;在空间操纵和模拟中,精确度达到22.8%,但在规则诱导中只有0.6%. 在涵盖所有四类的"十大任务"子集上,一个单一的机制提示没有揭示答案,将准确度从7.8%提高到55.6%,表明当前代理的主要弱点不在于执行多步骤计划,而在于从视觉证据中自行发现规则. 因此,改善长相视觉推理取决于教学人员从图像中发现规则并不断加以检查; Visual Cipher Beach为衡量这种能力提供了一个可靠的基准。
